channel.title: Besprited news and releases
channel.description: News and new releases of Besprited, a free and open source pixel-art and sprite animation editor.

item.title: Versioning change in Besprited
item.description: Starting with the March 2027 release, Besprited versions will drop the leading "1" major version, making v27.03.0 the version that will follow v1.26.12.

item.title: Besprited 1.26.09
item.description: Besprited 1.26.09 is out. Download it for Windows, macOS and Linux from https://besprited.veritaware.com/download.html
